question: How is the first divine lotus described in the meditation?
premises: A divine lotus is the object of meditation.
It has eight spokes or petals.
It is adorned by the first octad.
inference: The first divine lotus is eight-spoked and adorned by the first octad.
uncertainties: āraṃ may suggest spokes or radiating divisions depending on context.
plain_english: Meditate on the divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
